definitions.ask: When a capture creates a task inside a named Pomodoro of another type, should it merge rather than retype?
definitions.why: One landing rule everywhere; a free `#type` marker still types a new task explicitly

choices.label: The new task keeps its inherited type and the Pomodoro gains it, the same rule as every link
New tasks still take the Pomodoro's type; only existing tasks merge

definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+Shift+M drop a merged Pomodoro's type when the last Task Link of that type moves out?
definitions.why: A type travels with its tasks. Close uses the same shed rule, so names never go stale

definitions.requested: We should add an excellent new glossary term for "merged pomodoro".

definitions.ask: Record a decision that linking merges types and never retypes tasks?
